{{Quote|Instead of the usual payment method, we require your assistance. Help us in a small matter, and we will give you everything we have on the Esstran Cordon.|The local [[Spymaster/Legends|spymaster]]|<ref name="RES" />}}
The '''Esstran Cordon''' was the [[Blockade/Legends|blockade]] of the [[Esstran sector/Legends|Esstran sector]] by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==History==
{{Quote|The Y-wing strayed into an area where the Empire is testing some new starfighter designs. It's all here on this datacard. The Y-wing made an excellent test subject for the TIE prototypes. The pilot ejected when his ship was destroyed. We believe he is still alive and being held in the secure base inside the cordoned area.|The local [[Spymaster/Legends|spymaster]]|<ref name="RES" />}}
During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] did not consider this area of [[Realspace/Legends|space]] to contain any unusual danger.<ref name="RES" />

However, at some point between the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]] and the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]], the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] cordoned off this once-open [[Sector/Legends|sector]], and no unauthorized [[Starship/Legends|ships]] were allowed to enter the area. The Empire established a secure base inside the cordoned area and used it for testing new [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] designs.<ref name="RES" />

When [[Rebel pilot/Legends|Rebel pilot]] [[Zan Porpu]] entered the Esstran Cordon aboard his [[BTL Y-wing starfighter/Legends|Y-wing starfighter]], he was used as a test subject for [[TIE series/Legends|TIE]] prototypes.<ref name="RES" />

With their [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] missing in action, the Rebel Alliance turned to the [[Bothan Spynet/Legends|Bothan Spynet]] for help. The local [[Spymaster/Legends|spymaster]] agreed to give information on this matter in exchange for the rescue of a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Bothan/Legends|Bothan]] [[Agent/Legends|agent]], who was detained by the local Imperial authorities in a minor security facility.<ref name="RES" />

After the rescue, the spymaster agreed to honor his part of the bargain. He informed the Rebel Alliance that Zan Porpu ejected when his Y-wing starfighter was destroyed by a [[TIE Advanced x1/Legends|TIE Advanced x1]]. The Bothan Spynet believed the pilot was still alive and being held in the secure base inside the Esstran Cordon.<ref name="RES" />
